LESSON: READING FOR FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.9: Reading for Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading for Fluency, part of Reading in Grade 9 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How does reading fluently effectively improve communication skills?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read out vocabulary on locations and directions to each other with the correct pace (e.g. 地方/地点、 附近、最近、近,很近、远、很 远、在、方向、向,朝、往、 前、后、左、右、拐/转),

2. work jointly to describe the direction and location of things/places using cardinal points 北方、南方、东方、西方、东北 方、西北方、东南方、西南方 with the correct pace,

3. read short texts on direction and location and answer the corresponding questions,

4. take turns to role-play asking and giving directions in their locality using phrases 从......到...... 、怎么 去、去......怎么走、......离这儿 有多远? 、 在哪儿? 、 在哪里?,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read out vocabulary on locations and directions to each other with the correct pace (e.g. 地方/地点、 附近、最近、近,很近、远、很 远、在、方向、向,朝、往、 前、后、左、右、拐/转),
2. work jointly to describe the direction and location of things/places using cardinal points 北方、南方、东方、西方、东北 方、西北方、东南方、西南方 with the correct pace,
3. read short texts on direction and location and answer the corresponding questions,
4. take turns to role-play asking and giving directions in their locality using phrases 从......到...... 、怎么 去、去......怎么走、......离这儿 有多远? 、 在哪儿? 、 在哪里?,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading for Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and Imagination: the learner makes connections between different ideas as they deliberate how directional vocabulary

is used in their day-to-day life.

Values:
Peace: the learner displays calmness by patiently waiting for their turn to read instructions for their peers to give directions to

specific places.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Healthy interpersonal relationships are enhanced as the learner harmoniously takes turns to role-play asking and giving

directions in the locality.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the skills used in reading with appropriate pace and expression to reading fluency in English and Kiswahili.
